description: YAML file to .env text (generate env). Every case is decrypted with "key". "env" is the exact output, or "error" is the kind of failure; a failing file produces no output.

cases.name: the README example
cases.yaml:
base-url: http://localhost:3000
app-secret: SECRET;v1:ikceywABAgMEBQYHCAkKCyLDfmHplmR3TDvBmf48BQQ9Ry9u/Zx9DFyk6Ao=
port: 8080
debug: true
db:
  host: localhost
  nested:
    deep-key: deep-value
cases.env:
BASE_URL="http://localhost:3000"
APP_SECRET="s3cr3t-value"
PORT=8080
DEBUG=true
DB_HOST="localhost"
DB_NESTED_DEEP_KEY="deep-value"

cases.name: scalars that stay unquoted
cases.note: int, float and bool are written bare, rendered the way Dart prints them (see format.md, "Rendering a scalar")
cases.yaml:
int: 8080
negative: -3
hex: 0x1F
octal: 0o17
leading-zero: 007
plus: +12
float: 1.5
whole-float: 1.0
exponent: 1e3
small: 1.5e-7
inf: .inf
neg-inf: -.inf
nan: .nan
bool-true: true
bool-title: True
bool-upper: FALSE
cases.env:
INT=8080
NEGATIVE=-3
HEX=31
OCTAL=15
LEADING_ZERO=7
PLUS=12
FLOAT=1.5
WHOLE_FLOAT=1.0
EXPONENT=1000.0
SMALL=1.5e-7
INF=Infinity
NEG_INF=-Infinity
NAN=NaN
BOOL_TRUE=true
BOOL_TITLE=true
BOOL_UPPER=false

cases.name: scalars that stay strings
cases.yaml:
yes: yes
on: on
date: 2024-01-01
underscored: 1_000
quoted-int: '123'
quoted-bool: "true"
version: 1.2.3
empty-quoted: ""
cases.env:
YES="yes"
ON="on"
DATE="2024-01-01"
UNDERSCORED="1_000"
QUOTED_INT="123"
QUOTED_BOOL="true"
VERSION="1.2.3"
EMPTY_QUOTED=""

cases.name: null values
cases.yaml:
tilde: ~
word: null
title: Null
empty:

cases.name: escaping in plain values
cases.note: every string is escaped, plaintext or decrypted; a tab is left alone
cases.yaml:
quote: say "hi"
backslash: C:\path\to
tab: "a	b"
escaped-newline: "line1\nline2"
crlf: "a\r\nb"
hash-in-quotes: "x # y"
cases.env:
QUOTE="say \"hi\""
BACKSLASH="C:\\path\\to"
TAB="a	b"
ESCAPED_NEWLINE="line1\nline2"
CRLF="a\r\nb"
HASH_IN_QUOTES="x # y"

cases.name: block scalars
cases.yaml:
literal: |
  line one
  line two
folded: >
  folded
  text
stripped: |-
  no trailing newline
cases.env:
LITERAL="line one\nline two\n"
FOLDED="folded text\n"
STRIPPED="no trailing newline"

cases.name: secrets are decrypted and escaped
cases.yaml:
plain: not secret
token: SECRET;v1:ikceywABAgMEBQYHCAkKCyLDfmHplmR3TDvBmf48BQQ9Ry9u/Zx9DFyk6Ao=
pem: SECRET;v1:ikcey6ChoqOkpaanqKmqq8q5yc4vQguzofLaDLgKl7H05kR+Eq17zh2NQj91kUZDVx/V38R1lzLD4tnUQNbZu02Si+C//1jpquckewhfmoJxMXI6MYcKUAAavEhGUvmI+XJ8upw=
legacy: SECRET;ZhT41aiwJqTSMEmEil249aChoqOkpaanqKmqq5DmjZd2ZSDUisXaLIQ14cGO22YU+NWosCak0jBJhIpduPU=
quoted: "SECRET;v1:ikceywABAgMEBQYHCAkKCyLDfmHplmR3TDvBmf48BQQ9Ry9u/Zx9DFyk6Ao="
cases.env:
PLAIN="not secret"
TOKEN="s3cr3t-value"
PEM="-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\nline2\r\n\"quoted\" \\back # not a comment	tab"
LEGACY="written by pnv 1.x"

cases.name: key names
cases.yaml:
Api-Key: a
snake_case: b
dotted.key: c
with space: d
1: e
true: f
UPPER: g
cases.env:
API_KEY="a"
SNAKE_CASE="b"
DOTTED.KEY="c"
WITH SPACE="d"
1="e"
TRUE="f"
UPPER="g"

cases.name: nesting
cases.yaml:
a:
  b:
    c:
      d: deep
  e: shallow
empty: {}
flow: {host: x, port: 1}

cases.name: type comments are carried over
cases.note: the comment is read from the value's own line only, so db.port does not type top-port
cases.yaml:
port: # int
name: x # string
quoted: "y" # bool
number: 3 # num
spaced: z   #   int
bare-hash: w #
db:
  port: # int
top-port: 80
cases.env:
PORT= # int
NAME="x" # string
QUOTED="y" # bool
NUMBER=3 # num
SPACED="z" # int
BARE_HASH="w"
DB_PORT= # int
TOP_PORT=80

cases.name: a comment on its own line is not a type
cases.yaml:
# int
a: 1
# header
b:
  # nested
  c: 2

cases.name: anchors and aliases
cases.yaml:
base: &base
  host: h
  port: 1
copy: *base
name: &n value
again: *n
cases.env:
BASE_HOST="h"
BASE_PORT=1
COPY_HOST="h"
COPY_PORT=1
NAME="value"
AGAIN="value"

cases.name: CRLF line endings
cases.yaml:
a: 1 # int
b: two
c:
  d: three

cases.yaml: # nothing here
